Reference image for the [[Jokes]] block on [[Gamorrean Guard]]: a frame from the ''M*A*S*H'' episode "Check-Up" (season 3, episode 7, first aired on CBS on 22 October 1974). Trapper is holding his X-ray, moments after Hawkeye's "big, strong, dumb, silent types" line. Black bars removed and reduced to 960 pixels wide.

Source: a frame from the episode, supplied by the wiki's administrator. Episode details: [https://mash.fandom.com/wiki/Check-Up_(TV_series_episode) Check-Up (TV series episode)], M*A*S*H Wiki. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20250720000616/https://mash.fandom.com/wiki/Check-Up_(TV_series_episode) Internet Archive], 20 July 2025.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: one reduced frame (960 by 569 pixels) from the episode, the work the card's text echoes. It is used only to identify that work beside the card on [[Jokes]]. It cannot replace the original or harm its market, and no free image of it exists.
